relations.rationale: Nell arriving is a precondition for her unpacking the signal boxes, making it more plausible she then did so.
Nell arriving shortly after enables her later offering suggestions about track spacing.
Nell unpacking signal boxes has no bearing on whether Bo shares a class with Nell.
Zeno bringing the first-aid kit is unrelated to Finn and Bo's class assignment.
Zeno bringing the first-aid kit is unrelated to his displaying a restored steam engine.
Zeno bringing the first-aid kit has no connection to Nell's suggestions about track spacing.
Zeno bringing the first-aid kit does not indicate anything about Hugo's role as organizer.
Hugo checking the attendance sheet is the means by which he would determine who had arrived, supporting the claim about latecomers.
Checking an attendance sheet is unrelated to the size or theme of the largest layout.
The timing of latecomers is unrelated to when the refreshment table opens.
Latecomers being expected around noon does not directly relate to visitors arriving by late afternoon, though both are separate attendance events.
Finn being in the same class as Bo is consistent with Bo not being in the same class as Nell, since Finn and Nell classes aren't directly addressed, but it doesn't establish that relation.
Finn's class relation to Bo has no bearing on Nell's competition ranking.

If Finn is in the same class as Bo, and Bo is not in the same class as Nell (implied elsewhere), this supports Finn not being in Nell's class, but taken alone with just claim 14, it doesn't establish this without additional info.
The largest layout being a mountain scene is consistent with and does not preclude it also sitting near the main door, and 16 elaborates on 15's subject.
The largest layout's location near the main door is unrelated to Nell's suggestions about track spacing at the far end of the hall.
The layout's placement near the door has no bearing on whether Hugo is the event organizer.
Bo's class relationship with Nell is unrelated to Zeno's steam engine display.
Bo not being in Nell's class has no bearing on Nell's ranking in the competition.
Bo not being in the same class as Nell does not determine whether Finn is in the same class as Nell.
